name: Kapha Chintamani Rasa

sections.reference_bhaishajya_ratnavali_kapharoga: Kapha Chintamani Rasa is an Ayurvedic medicine, with herbal and mineral ingredients, in tablet form. It is used in respiratory conditions and arthritis.
sections.ingredients:
Equal quantities of herbal powders of:- 

 Hingula – Purified Cinnabar – 10gm 
 Indrayava – Seeds of Holarrhena antidysenterica – 10gm 
 Tankana – Purified Borax – 10gm 
 Trailokya beeja – Seed of Cannabis indica -10gm 
 Maricha – Black pepper – Piper nigrum – 10gm 
 Ras sindura – 30 parts 

 How to Make? 
 All ingredients are mixed with ginger juice and pills are made.
sections.dosage: 1 – 2 tablets once or twice a day before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor.
sections.indications:
Vata imbalance diseases such as arthritis, paralysis etc. 
 Respiratory conditions such as cough, cold, bronchitis etc.
sections.side_effects:
This medicine should only be taken under strict medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous. 

 Note:- 

 It is to be avoided in children and pregnant ladies. 
 Over dosage may cause many side effects including gastritis. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Kapha Chintamani Rasa 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali Kapharoga Chikitsa 2/10. 
 Kapha Chintamani Rasa is an Ayurvedic medicine, with herbal and mineral ingredients, in tablet form. It is used in respiratory conditions and arthritis. 
 Ingredients 
 Equal quantities of herbal powders of:- 
 
 Hingula – Purified Cinnabar – 10gm 
 Indrayava – Seeds of Holarrhena antidysenterica – 10gm 
 Tankana – Purified Borax – 10gm 
 Trailokya beeja – Seed of Cannabis indica -10gm 
 Maricha – Black pepper – Piper nigrum – 10gm 
 Ras sindura – 30 parts 
 
 How to Make? 
 All ingredients are mixed with ginger juice and pills are made. 
 Dosage 
 1 – 2 tablets once or twice a day before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Indications 
 
 Vata imbalance diseases such as arthritis, paralysis etc. 
 Respiratory conditions such as cough, cold, bronchitis etc. 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 This medicine should only be taken under strict medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous. 
 
 Note:- 
 
 It is to be avoided in children and pregnant ladies. 
 Over dosage may cause many side effects including gastritis. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
